description.value: The Echo Community Centre & Swimming Pool is a municipally operated aquatic and fitness facility in Port Alberni, a central Vancouver Island hub for cyclists travelling the Island or Alberni Valley routes. As a public sports centre with a swimming pool, it may offer showers and washrooms that would benefit touring cyclists, though specific amenities could not be confirmed from available sources. Port Alberni sits at the head of the Alberni Inlet and serves as a logical overnight or rest stop on multi-day island cycling itineraries.
